english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is easily irritated or short-tempered.
Use this colloquial expression for someone who is characteristically short-tempered or quick to flare up.
Use this for the irritable or short-tempered side of impatience, especially when someone is restless.
Use this specifically for someone who is easily irritated or quick to lose their temper.
Use this for someone who is habitually short-tempered and easily angered.
Use this colloquial word for someone who becomes angry easily.

examples.english: They’re really tetchy; even the slightest thing can make them lose their temper.
Ming is bad-tempered and blows up over the slightest thing.
examples.traditional: 阿明好燥底，少少事都會發火。
